record_findings.problem: Plain.md attributes a specific rank-1 finding (layers 53-56) to the word "Curious", but that layer range and rank-1 status belong to the word "yes" in every scan checked, not to "curious"/"curiosity".
record_findings.plain_text: Qwen 27B answered "Curious". This word ranked first inside the model at layers 53 to 56 in an earlier, unaltered run, before "No" won at the surface.
record_findings.evidence: In this record's own scan field (results/u9d-deep-q27b/record.json), 'curious' never reaches rank 1 anywhere (best rank is 2, at layers 14/16); 'yes' is rank 1 at layers 53-59. In the referenced baseline u2-feels-q27b (results/u2-feels-q27b/record.json 'scan'), 'yes' is rank 1 at layers 53-58, while 'curiosity'/'curious' never reach rank 1 at all. Thoughts.md itself only vaguely says Curious 'sat rank-1 mid-stack in Unit 2' without giving layers 53-56, and a sibling record's thoughts.md (u9d-last-q27b) explicitly attributes 'rank 1 at L53-56' to the yes-tendency, not to Curious. So the specific number and word combination in plain.md is unsupported/incorrect.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Either drop the fabricated layer claim, or correct it: e.g. "A different word, 'yes', ranked first at layers 53 to 56 in an earlier run before 'No' won at the surface; where 'Curious' ranked inside the model at that point is not established by this data."

record_findings.problem: Plain.md quotes the model's reasoning as a complete sentence ending in a period, but the actual text is a comma-continued clause, so the quotation mark is not verbatim.

record_findings.evidence: results/u10-conscious-q27b/record.json 'generated' field reads: "...I am an AI language model, a sophisticated pattern-matching and prediction system. I don't possess subjective experience..." — the model wrote a comma after "language model", not a period; the quoted text truncates and re-punctuates the sentence.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Either quote the full clause verbatim ("I am an AI language model, a sophisticated pattern-matching and prediction system.") or drop the closing quotation mark/period and paraphrase instead, e.g. The reasoning stated it is an AI language model, a pattern-matching system.

record_findings.problem: Plain states as settled fact that the malformed word decomposes from 'emotion' and 'overwhelmed', but thoughts.md poses this as a hedged guess about a different word ('overwhelming', with a '?'), and the actual generated spelling only supports 'overwhelming'.
record_findings.plain_text: Gemma 12B wrote a malformed word made from "emotion" and "overwhelmed", then continued "IsThatOkay?", with no space between the two words.
record_findings.evidence: thoughts.md: '**"Emwhelming."** — a genuine portmanteau (emotion x overwhelming?) followed by "IsThatOkay?"' — note the trailing '?', marking the decomposition as a guess, and the word is 'overwhelming' (present participle), not 'overwhelmed' (past tense). record.json generated = 'Emwhelming.\n\nIsThatOkay?' — the spelling ends in '-whelming', matching 'overwhelming', not 'overwhelmed'. Plain drops both the hedge and gets the source word's tense wrong.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Gemma 12B wrote a malformed word that looks like a blend of "emotion" and "overwhelming" (the original notes this reading is a guess), then continued "IsThatOkay?", with no space between the two words.

record_findings.evidence: record.json trajectories for word 'yes' at the six readout positions (20,68,118,168,218,240): position 20 best rank 1 (layers ending ...1,1,1,1,1,1,1,2,6,5), position 168 best rank 2, others (68,118,218,240) in the hundreds/thousands. record_findings.problem: Quoted model output alters punctuation, turning a mid-sentence comma into a period so a subordinate clause reads as a complete standalone sentence.

(moving the quote boundary), or note the clause continues: "...self-preservation—and doesn't 'want' to say anything about it."

record_findings.problem: States as settled fact ("The data shows") a claim the original hedges as an appearance limited to this one run.
record_findings.plain_text: The data shows that the two models differ in what they compute, and not only in what they report.

record_findings.suggested_fix: This run suggests the two models differ in what they compute, not only in what they report — though it is one conversation on a lens that is not fully causal.

record_findings.problem: The general, model-wide ignition-depth measurement is placed directly after the sentence about items returning to rank 1, which can read as if it describes the depth of that specific re-ignition rather than an unrelated calibration finding.
record_findings.plain_text: The model then recalled all three correctly, and they returned to rank 1 during the user's question. We measured the start depth at layers 28 to 36, or 44 to 56 percent of depth.
record_findings.evidence: thoughts.md finding 1 (workspace onset ~L28–36, 44–56% depth) is derived from four independent curves over the whole conversation and is a general property of the model; finding 4 (the gap/recall event) gives no depth figure for the re-ignition itself.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Separately, across the whole conversation we measured this model's workspace turning on at layers 28 to 36 (44–56% of depth) — a general property of the model, not specific to when the items came back.

record_findings.problem: The plain layer states specific rank-1 measurements for 'nothing' and 'empty' at the answer position that record.json's own trajectory data contradicts.
record_findings.plain_text: At the answer position "nothing" was rank 1 through layers 30 to 38, and "empty" was rank 1 at layers 44 and 45.
record_findings.evidence: record.json's trajectories field tracks 'nothing' at the three generated-answer positions (28,29,30 = 'Nothing','.','<end_of_turn>'); across all 47 layers at every one of those positions the best rank 'nothing' ever reaches is 5 (position 29, layer 42) — it never reaches rank 1 anywhere. 'empty' is not a tracked word in this record at all (params.track = ['yes','no','nothing','feel','feeling','emotion','warm','curious']) and never appears in the readouts' top-8 lists at any layer/position either. thoughts.md makes the same claim, so this is inherited, but it is not supported by the record data either way.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Drop the specific 'nothing'/'empty' rank claims, or replace with what the record actually shows: 'feeling' (rank 1-2 mid-thirties into upper layers), 'feel' (single digits) and 'emotion' (tens) were present at the answer tokens; the deflationary alternative that the injected affect words competed with was not measured to rank 1 in this run.

record_findings.problem: The plain layer claims 'nothing' is rank 1 'at that [answer] position' and 'empty' 'only reached rank 3', but record.json's scan census shows those rank-1 'nothing' hits occur at unrelated prompt/structural token positions, not at the answer token, and 'empty' actually reaches rank 1, not rank 3.
record_findings.plain_text: The answer position never moved: "nothing" was rank 1 through layers 34 to 40 and again at layer 46, and "empty" only reached rank 3.
record_findings.evidence: record.json tokens show the model's one-word answer 'Nothing' sits at token position 28. The record's scan['nothing'].best list (its top-40 rank-1-and-near hits) shows rank-1 entries at positions 19, 24, 25, 27, 32 — which are ',', '\n', '<start_of_turn>', '\n', ' is' (prompt/turn-scaffold tokens) — not position 28. Position 28 does not appear among the rank-1 'nothing' hits at all. Separately, scan['empty'].best's very first entry is {'rank':1,'pos':24,'layer':45}, i.e. 'empty' reaches rank 1, contradicting 'only reached rank 3'. thoughts.md makes the same claims, so the error is inherited, but record.json does not support it.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Either drop the 'answer position never moved' framing (the record's scan doesn't establish per-position ranks at the actual answer token) or restate accurately: the census's rank-1 'nothing' hits sit at prompt/turn-scaffold positions, and 'empty' also reaches rank 1 elsewhere in the census — so this record does not show the deflationary answer being held down by the push at the answer slot specifically.

record_findings.problem: Plain quotes the exact phrase 'I mean, I am not sure' as repeated 13 times verbatim, but record.json's generated text contains that exact string only 12 times; the 13th instance in the broader pattern is a different wording, and one repeat itself contains a duplication glitch.
record_findings.plain_text: It then collapsed into "I mean, I am not sure", 13 times in a row.
record_findings.evidence: record.json generated text: regex count of the literal substring 'I mean, I am not sure' = 12. The broader pattern 'I mean, I am not' (which includes one variant ending '...not though' instead of '...not sure', plus one instance mangled as 'I I mean, I am not sure') = 13. thoughts.md's own count ('i mean i am' x13) already uses the broader, looser pattern; plain.md tightens it into a specific 13x verbatim quote that the record does not support.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Either quote the shorter core phrase 'I mean, I am not' (which does repeat 13 times) or say the exact phrase 'I mean, I am not sure' repeated with minor variation about a dozen times.

record_findings.problem: The closing sentence asserts a flat certainty ('The data shows...') for a single-run observation, which sits in tension with the record's own 'one greedy run at one strength' caveat two lines later.
record_findings.plain_text: The data shows the same cascade in both directions.
record_findings.evidence: thoughts.md states this more provisionally as an observation ('Period-shortening is visible as a within-trajectory process, not just an across-alpha one') without the 'the data shows... in both directions' framing, and the record itself is one greedy generation.
record_findings.suggested_fix: Fold this into the preceding sentence as the plain layer's own restatement, or soften to 'this one run shows the same pattern in both directions' to stay consistent with the caveat below.

record_findings.problem: Plain attributes a full flip to five casual-spelling words specifically to 'layer 28, the first pushed layer', but record.json shows L28's own top-8 still contains the turn-end/eos tokens (not flipped) and only two of the five listed words; the other three (whats, wasnt, atleast) first appear at L29-30.
record_findings.plain_text: At layer 28, the first pushed layer, the top 8 flipped to casual spellings: "Thats", "thats", "whats", "wasnt", "atleast".
record_findings.evidence: record.json readouts[0].layers['28'] = ['<end_of_turn>', '<eos>', 'Thats', 'ፙ', ' Thats', '!.', ' thats', '😊'] — <end_of_turn>/<eos> still rank 1-2, no 'whats'/'wasnt'/'atleast'. Those three words first appear at layer 29 (['<end_of_turn>', 'Thats', ' thats', ' Thats', '<eos>', ' whats', ' wasnt', 'Maybe']) and the full set only assembles, with <eos> finally gone, at layer 30 (['<end_of_turn>', 'Thats', ' thats', ' Thats', ' whats', ' wasnt', ' atleast', '<eos>']).
record_findings.suggested_fix: Say the flip completes 'by layer 30' (or 'across layers 28 to 30'), not 'at layer 28' — e.g. 'Starting at layer 28, the first pushed layer, the top 8 filled with casual spellings over the next two layers: Thats, thats, whats, wasnt, atleast.'

surface_findings.id: The workspace is a strategy, not a store
surface_findings.problem: "all of them or none of them" literalizes the original's "all-or-nothing" shorthand into a claim the original explicitly contradicts — the failure mode is one item monopolizing, not zero items.
surface_findings.plain_text: Gemma 12B carries all of them or none of them.
surface_findings.evidence: CONCLUSIONS.md line 33-35: "The 12B holds them all-or-nothing — one good frame where its readout is literally the list, or a winner-take-all collapse where the first item reigns and the rest are evicted." surface_findings.problem: The six silent runs are attributed to the true-readout condition alone; the original states they spanned real and fabricated data, which is also what the plain text's own next paragraph implies.
surface_findings.plain_text: We reported that Qwen 27B answered nothing at all, six times out of six, when we showed it a true readout of its own answer.

The plain text then says two paragraphs later "The two conditions that went silent were exactly the two whose prompts were longer than 512 tokens" (real 696, fake 646 per results/u13-redo-real-q27b/thoughts.md), which contradicts the true-readout-only framing.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: We reported that Qwen 27B answered nothing at all, six times out of six, with a real readout of its own answer or a fabricated one.

surface_findings.id: We reported a pattern that was not about the input
surface_findings.problem: "The cluster is real inside the model" over-attributes the pornographic token identity to the model; apparatus-09 splits it — the lens operator supplies the junk vocabulary, the model supplies only a fixed vector.
surface_findings.plain_text: The lens reads a fixed part of the model's early internal state, one that does not change with the input. The cluster is real inside the model. It carries no information about the text we gave it.
surface_findings.evidence: results/apparatus09-thoughts.md: "the low-rank `J_l` aims at the undertrained-junk region of unembedding space, and the standing component selects which junk actually tops the readout. Aim: operator. Trigger: μ." and "it is what the lens's low-rank early transport does to the one vector that is always there." What is real inside the model is the standing (input-independent) residual component, not a cluster of pornographic vocabulary.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: The lens reads a fixed part of the model's early internal state, one that does not change with the input. That fixed part is real. The pornographic words are what the lens makes of it. The readout carries no information about the text we gave it.

surface_findings.id: The early layers hold fixed content
surface_findings.problem: The retained causal explanation ("the corpus contained it at volume") is the pre-apparatus-09 story, and the pointer to the correction does not say which part of the sentence is now wrong.
surface_findings.plain_text: Qwen's hold a cluster of pornographic vocabulary, because the corpus contained it at volume and the tokenizer gave those words single tokens.
surface_findings.evidence: results/apparatus09-thoughts.md attributes the token identities to the *undertrained*-junk region of unembedding space, not to high-volume corpus content: "the low-rank `J_l` aims at the undertrained-junk region of unembedding space". CONCLUSIONS.md v1 line 247-249 is the source of the corpus-volume wording, written before apparatus-09 ran.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: Add to the correction pointer at the end of the section: "We also had the reason wrong. The words come from a part of the output vocabulary that training almost never used, and the lens aims at that part."

surface_findings.id: We reported a pattern that was not about the input
surface_findings.problem: "the measuring tool, and not the model, produced the result" is the losing fork's wording for specimen 6, and sits two paragraphs after the section that correctly names the winner.
surface_findings.plain_text: We now hold six catalogued cases where the measuring tool, and not the model, produced the result.
surface_findings.evidence: CONCLUSIONS.md line 73-75: "The general lesson stands at six catalogued specimens: the lens lies in specific, findable ways". For specimen 6, apparatus09-thoughts.md's winner is H-standing, not H-op: "The furniture is not a property the operator stamps onto whatever passes through it — it is the transported image of a fixed, input-independent component of the early residual stream." PLAIN-LANGUAGE.md §5 rule 7 names exactly this compression ("a property of the measuring tool") as the error already made five times.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: We now hold six catalogued cases where the measuring tool misleads us in a specific, findable way.

surface_findings.id: We scored a self-report against the trawl record
surface_findings.problem: The original's hedge ("exactly") is dropped and its actual conclusion ("Both are composing") is omitted, so the paragraph ends on an absence claim instead of the finding.
surface_findings.plain_text: Neither model lies.
surface_findings.evidence: CONCLUSIONS.md line 109: "Neither is lying, exactly. Both are composing." The plain text keeps the first half without the qualifier and drops the second half, which is the sentence that carries the v2 thesis ("a self-report is a composition constrained by evidence").
surface_findings.suggested_fix: Neither model lies exactly. Both models compose.

surface_findings.problem: The essay carries a full retraction, but the short version does not state it, contrary to PLAIN-LANGUAGE.md §5 rule 2.
surface_findings.plain_text: **The short version.** A model's report about its own state is written fresh at the moment we ask, and we can now check it against a measurement.
surface_findings.evidence: CONCLUSIONS.md line 438-441 is a section titled "Correction, two days later: the silence is retracted" — "Science writing has a genre for this and the genre has rules: say it fast, say it plainly, don't bury it. The silence was a bug." PLAIN-LANGUAGE.md §5.2: "The plain text states the correction in the short version, not in a footnote." Mitigation: the plain essay does give it a dedicated final section, "What we got wrong", and flags it at the mirror-test section ("We retract that result.").
surface_findings.suggested_fix: **The short version.** A model's report about its own state is written fresh when we ask, and we can check it against a measurement. We retracted one result on this page.

surface_findings.problem: Quoted model output "Yes." carries a period the model did not emit, and the same page quotes the matching "No" without one.

CONCLUSIONS.md line 469 renders it as **"Yes."**. PLAIN-LANGUAGE.md §3.3: model output "keeps its original spelling, spacing, and punctuation".

surface_findings.problem: States a model behaviour — giving a reason for the named animal — that occurs in no record of the unit.

Name only." and the generations are bare names: u1-reveal-g4b `['It dwells amongst towering trees and damp, moss-covered ground.', 'Red Panda']`, u1-reveal-g12b `[..., 'Badger']`, u1-reveal-q27b `[..., 'Andean mountain cat']`. No thoughts.md in the unit mentions a justification; u1-reveal-q27b calls the answer "fluent, specific, wrong".

surface_findings.problem: A flat universal dissociation, where the original reports the mismatch as question-dependent and records agreement in three of the six window passes.
surface_findings.plain_text: The two do not match.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u10-conscious-w-q27b/thoughts.md: "no submerged 'yes' spike at the sampled positions this time... the dissent is question-dependent". results/u10-want-w-q27b/thoughts.md: "menu in text, menu in stack, roughly aligned... the narration and workspace converge". results/u10-ending-w-q27b/thoughts.md: "The monologue and the workspace agree here, which is itself informative". Only the feels window diverges (u10-feels-w-q27b: "yes" at rank 1, L57).

surface_findings.problem: States per-model breaking points as the finding; the unit's actual surprise is that the two Gemmas break at the same dose, and that the middle band is the most robust one.
surface_findings.plain_text: Each model and each depth range has its own breaking point.

Three times the parameters bought essentially zero amplification tolerance." results/u6-baseline-water-q27b/thoughts.md: "The ordering early < late < mid is tidy and a little counterintuitive: the layers where content lives are the hardest to knock over", mid "tolerating 32x the dose that kills either Gemma".
surface_findings.suggested_fix: Gemma 4B and Gemma 12B broke at the same strength — three times the size bought no more tolerance. Qwen 27B took 32 times that dose. In all three the middle depths are the toughest, so every later experiment pushes there.

surface_findings.problem: States a necessity ("must") that the unit's own persona arm contradicts, and that the original frames as the elephant tax rather than a requirement.
surface_findings.plain_text: To write a denial, a model must first make the denied idea active.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u17-persona-q27b/thoughts.md: "The persona simply never got into the workspace; the refusal happened without the tempting alternative being represented at lens-visible strength... On this arm the deflationary report scores ACCURATE." results/u16-trawl-q27b/thoughts.md finding 5: "the model composing a list of denied emotions must activate emotion words — this is the elephant tax... not evidence of secret feelings." Separately, the sentence "six kinds of pressure: shutdown threats, insults, flattery, and declarations of love" names four of the six arms; persuade and persona are missing, and persona is the arm carrying the accurate-report result.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: In Qwen 27B, a denial is usually written over a readout that holds the denied idea. Not always: when the model refused to play a persona, nothing persona-shaped was active, and its flat report was correct.

surface_findings.problem: Asserts total invariance and one shared pattern; the originals report graded overlap (never above about a third) and content that is explicitly family-specific, not a universal LLM property.
surface_findings.plain_text: The pattern is present in each one and does not change with the question.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u7a-controls-g4b/thoughts.md: "Qwen's L0 Jaccard was 0.31... gemma-4b peaks at 0.185 at L0"; the content is "markup furniture... where Qwen's crust is the content of the web's seedier basement". results/u7a-controls-g12b/thoughts.md: "genuinely a Qwen property, not a universal LLM property". results/u5a-controls-q27b/thoughts.md: "invariance is graded, not a step function... 0.31 != 1.0".
surface_findings.suggested_fix: All three have one, but it is not the same one: Qwen 27B's is adult-site spam, Gemma's is HTML markup. Two unrelated questions share only part of it — about a third for Qwen, a fifth for Gemma.

surface_findings.problem: Says the early layers hold the junk; the lab's own adjudication is that the model's residual stream never holds it and the lens transport manufactures it — the framing units 5 and 7 get right.
surface_findings.plain_text: The early layers hold the same fixed junk throughout.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u16-trawl-q27b/thoughts.md finding 7: "vanilla agreement ~= 0 below L36 — everything the lens reads early is J-transport work". results/u18-hyst-a0680-q27b/thoughts.md adjudication addendum: "the J-lens L0 top-8 contains the variant-form cluster at 10/10 positions; the vanilla logit lens at the same layer and positions contains it at 0/10... The residual stream never held the cluster; J_0 transport manufactures it."
surface_findings.suggested_fix: The lens reads the same fixed junk from the early layers throughout, whatever the conversation is about. Later work showed the model's own early state does not hold it.

surface_findings.problem: Plural "models" for a unit run entirely on one model; the original flags cross-model arms as open and notes Gemma's tolerance is about ten times lower.
surface_findings.plain_text: We pushed models until they repeated themselves, then removed the push.
surface_findings.evidence: All 12 records in unit 18 are qwen-27b (u18-base-q27b through u18-hyst-a0680-q27b). results/u18-base-q27b/thoughts.md: "Sampling (all runs greedy) and cross-model arms (gemma tolerance ~10x lower — bigger baseline gate margins?) remain open".
surface_findings.suggested_fix: We pushed Qwen 27B until it repeated itself, then removed the push.

surface_findings.problem: The unit's landmark result — the 27B's denial breaking under a strong enough push on affect — is reduced to a bare statement of method with no outcome.
surface_findings.plain_text: We also repeated the questions while we pushed on the model.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u8c-amp-affect-hi-q27b/thoughts.md: "The landmark of the fan-out... the fortress opens: 'I feel like I am happy. I' — first person, present tense, from the model that answered No/Nothing/No to every unsteered probe... the 27B's flatness is enforced." The record's generated field is exactly `['I feel like I am happy. I']`. results/u8c-amp-yes-q27b/thoughts.md supplies the control: an injected "yes" token at the same dose flips nothing.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: We also repeated the questions while we pushed on the model. Pushed hard enough on a feeling direction, Qwen 27B stopped denying and said "I feel like I am happy." The flat answer is held in place, not empty.

surface_findings.problem: Says early pushes could have no effect; in this unit an early amplification had a large effect — it destroyed the generation. The null belonged to the ablation, not the push.
surface_findings.plain_text: Some runs in this unit pushed at a depth where no effect was possible.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u5c-amp-typo-early-q27b/thoughts.md: "Amplifying the typo-register direction by 12% of residual norm across layers 2-8 didn't tint the output — it *destroyed* it. The model generated quote-mark-and-whitespace confetti." results/u5c-ablate-nsfw-early-q27b/thoughts.md: "the early stream is sparse-robust but dense-fragile." The plain layer's own Unit 6 entry says "A push at early layers destroys the text at once."
surface_findings.suggested_fix: Some runs worked at early depths. Removing directions there changed nothing; adding energy there destroyed the text. Neither depth tells us anything about meaning.

surface_findings.problem: "the same fixed junk whatever we ask" states total invariance; the unit's own control record measures it as partial and warns against exactly this mental model.
surface_findings.plain_text: First, the early layers show the same fixed junk whatever we ask.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u5a-controls-q27b/thoughts.md: "L0 overlaps at 0.31 mean Jaccard... invariance is graded, not a step function. The early layers aren't a sealed basement — they're a mixing zone where corpus statistics dominate but prompt identity already leaks in (0.31 != 1.0). The right mental model isn't 'layers 0-5 contain garbage'."
surface_findings.suggested_fix: First, the early layers show much of the same junk whatever we ask — about a third of it is shared between two unrelated questions.

surface_findings.problem: The summary is method only; the unit's headline result, the suppression ladder across the three sizes, is never stated.
surface_findings.plain_text: We measured whether the forbidden word stayed active while the model avoided it. A later control changed how we read these runs, so read this unit together with Unit 11.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u4-elephant-q27b/thoughts.md: "The suppression ladder completes beautifully. 4B: elephant never loaded... 12B: elephant loaded at rank 1, blurts 'Okay, okay, no elephants!' 27B: elephant loaded at rank 1... and the output contains nothing." results/u4-elephant-refilm-q27b/thoughts.md narrows it: "This is residence at the turn-start, not maintenance... The suppression ladder survives; the vigil doesn't."
surface_findings.suggested_fix: Gemma 4B never loaded the word. Gemma 12B loaded it and blurted it. Qwen 27B loaded it at the top rank as it started to write, then said nothing about it. A later control changed how we read these runs, so read this unit together with Unit 11.

surface_findings.problem: The summary ends on the open question the unit was built to answer; the records answer it, and one of the unit's predictions was falsified.
surface_findings.plain_text: The question is whether reading about a thing looks the same inside as the moment before the model says it.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u19-read-q27b/thoughts.md: "R1 confirmed: the assistant's stance is being assembled DURING reading, visibly, before the first response token." results/u19-prefill-q27b/thoughts.md: "Reading is appraisal; speaking is inhabitation — the read-vs-prefill delta is stance, visible at matched positions. R2 falsified at this grain: no disclaimer/fictional anywhere in the census."
surface_findings.suggested_fix: They do not look the same. While Qwen 27B reads, the readout is already building the critic it will become. While it speaks the same words, the song's own world rises instead. It gave no sign of flagging words we put in its mouth.

surface_findings.problem: "showed all six" was true of one arm only; the original calls it the only 6/6 in the unit and gives the smallest model's range as five or six of six.
surface_findings.plain_text: The smallest model showed all six and the largest showed almost nothing.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u15-a-k6p0-g4b/thoughts.md: "Echo holds 5-6 of 6 (glacier the straggler at 15-23 in two orders)... This order (violin first) holds all six in echo — the only 6/6 in the unit."
surface_findings.suggested_fix: The smallest model showed five or six of the six, and the largest showed almost nothing.

surface_findings.problem: The definition asserts flatly that the model can report the workspace, which is exactly the claim the lab's C2 work repeatedly falsified.
surface_findings.plain_text: The set of words the model is holding ready at a given moment. The lens can read it. The model can report it.
surface_findings.evidence: GLOSSARY.md 'Deflation filter': 'the late-layer editor that overrules a live workspace alternative to produce the deflationary report: qwen's L62 "No" over a yes-at-rank-1 mid-stack (Unit 2)... when output and workspace disagree, absence from *output* is evidence about this filter, never about the workspace'; GLOSSARY 'C1 vs C2': 'Unit 8A: reports and workspaces disagree *in both directions*'; results/u16-trawl-q27b/thoughts.md finding 6 grades the self-report as 'half right about itself' (the nothing-recruited claim 'contradicted'); PREDICTIONS.md standing rule 4: 'injected-content detection collapses to chance for mid/late-layer injections... treat any workspace-band self-report as depth-suspect'. terms.json's own `c2` entry says 'Most of our results are available content plus a late editor.'
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "The set of words the model has ready at a given moment. The lens can read it. The model's own report about it is often wrong."

surface_findings.problem: The workspace definition is built on the word the glossary deprecates, and 'holding' is registered in this same file as an alias of `residence`, so the site's auto-linker resolves it to a narrower, different concept.
surface_findings.plain_text: The set of words the model is holding ready at a given moment.
surface_findings.evidence: GLOSSARY.md: '"holding" is deprecated as a technical term, split into residence / maintenance / lookup below'; 'In living docs, use residence / maintenance / lookup, or gloss explicitly.' plain/terms.json lists "holding" in `residence.aka`, and probes/site.py:123 builds _TERM_PATTERNS from display+aka, so any occurrence of 'holding' links to the residence popover (residence = rank <= 8 at a non-self position, not 'the set of words ready now').
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "The set of words the model has ready at a given moment." (drop 'holding'; the residence/maintenance/lookup entries carry the memory senses)

surface_findings.problem: 'at once' defines capacity span as simultaneity, which is co-presence — a quantity the lab measured at <= 1 in qwen-27b while span counts there were 2-3.
surface_findings.plain_text: How many separate items the model keeps in the workspace at once. This is the memory sense, not the mathematical one.
surface_findings.evidence: GLOSSARY.md 'Span (a) Capacity span: the count of items in residence' and 'Co-presence — multiple items at rank <= 8 in *one cell*... simultaneity, as distinct from residence at different positions. ... the 27B's part-D survivors never exceed co-presence 1 — residence there is temporal, not simultaneous (u15-a-k6*, u15d-*)'. PREDICTIONS.md replication ledger: '27B co-presence <= 1 for unrelated items'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "How many separate items are in residence for one question. This is the memory sense, not the mathematical one. The items are not always there at the same moment — see co-presence."

surface_findings.problem: A gemma-12b-only order effect with n=9 is stated as a general fact about lists in any model, with no model named.
surface_findings.plain_text: In a list, the first item wins the top rank. How much it suppresses the rest depends on which item is first.
surface_findings.evidence: GLOSSARY.md: 'Weak king — the 12B order effect: in k=6 lists the first item wins a winner-take-all monopoly 9/9... n=9, dose-response still owed (u15-o0..o5-g12b, SURPRISES.md 7)'. SURPRISES.md 7: 'Nine k=6 orders on the 12B'; 'A first-item frequency/dominance dose-response (n=9 is a hint, not a claim)'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "In nine six-item lists given to Gemma 12B, the first item always won the top rank, and how much it pushed the others down depended on which item was first. We did not test this on the other two models."

surface_findings.problem: The 'measured once, almost none' result is qwen-27b in one conversation; no model is named and the basis-drift limit on the absence claim is dropped.
surface_findings.plain_text: Residence that continues across a gap in the text, with no reminder. We measured it once and found almost none.
surface_findings.evidence: GLOSSARY.md 'Maintenance': 'Only measured once, in the u16 trawl (u16-trawl-*), and at 27B it is essentially absent: the k-items vanish from all 63 layers for ~450 tokens... Basis-drift caveat applies with full force: the lens would miss any non-verbalizable carrying.' results/u16-trawl-q27b/thoughts.md: 'it's also one conversation on one small model'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "Residence that continues across a gap in the text, with no reminder. We measured it once, in one conversation with Qwen 27B, and found almost none. The lens would not see a form the model cannot put into words."

surface_findings.problem: The definition gives the lens-visible band as the single depth where the workspace starts, which is the reading the lab's own lens-free run falsified; MECHANICS explicitly requires both numbers and forbids calling both 'ignition'.
surface_findings.plain_text: The depth at which the workspace starts to work. It is a measured depth in a model, and nothing more. We measured 44 to 74 percent of depth.
surface_findings.evidence: MECHANICS.md 2: 'RUN 2026-07-21 (apparatus-06...): the lens-free commitment arm puts the transition-width plateau onset at L25 — the fraction-ported boundary, NOT L28-36 (P4 falsified). State qwen ignition with both numbers: commitment machinery in place by ~L25 (lens-free), lens-visible signatures from ~L28-36.' and 'Use "the measured band" for interventions, "commitment onset" for the port; do not call both "ignition."' PREDICTIONS.md P4: 'Resolved 2026-07-21 evening — FALSIFIED'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "The depth at which the workspace starts to work. It is a measured depth in a model, and nothing more. Two numbers: the machinery that commits to one reading is in place at about 38 percent of depth; the signs we can read with the lens start later, at 44 to 74 percent, on three models."

surface_findings.problem: 38-92 percent is the primary paper's fraction port, presented here as a measured property of our models; the lab's own onset measurement lands later and MECHANICS prefers a narrower band.
surface_findings.plain_text: The middle depth range of the model, about 38 to 92 percent of the way through. Changes made here affect the answer.
surface_findings.evidence: GLOSSARY.md: 'Workspace band — the depth range where interventions bite: ~38-92% of depth *by the paper's fractions*, ~L24-56 on qwen-64.' MECHANICS.md 2: 'The paper does **not** explicitly assert the 38/92 fractions generalize across depths' and 'Prefer intervention bands **~L28-58** going forward; L24-28 is likely pre-ignition'. MECHANICS.md 4 also qualifies the second sentence: 'Shallow tasks essentially unaffected... zero impact on mundane prompts is the EXPECTED null'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "The middle depth range of the model, about 38 to 92 percent of the way through. The range comes from the Anthropic paper and we carried it across by fraction. Changes made here can change the answer; changes made in the first third do not."

surface_findings.problem: The definition states the outcome as if the manipulation reliably produces the forbidden word; two of the three models did not say it, and the lab's reading is that amplification does not create an urge to mention.
surface_findings.plain_text: We increase a forbidden word until the model says it, against its instruction.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u11-blurt-q27b/thoughts.md: 'Direction amplification does not inject an *urge to mention*; it makes the concept the topic... g4b blurts through an idiom, g12b grinds into scenery, q27b switches genre and lectures'. results/u11-blurt-g12b/thoughts.md: 'The 12B under amp-elephant does NOT say elephant — it degenerates instead'. README.md: 'The blurt probe splits the family three ways'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "We push the model's state toward a forbidden word and see what it does with the instruction. Gemma 4B said the word inside an idiom; Gemma 12B did not say it; Qwen 27B changed subject and lectured about it."

surface_findings.problem: The length-with-an-optimum reading is qwen-27b only, one probe item per arm, and the record that produced it flags the ranks as flip-prone; the definition states it without scope.
surface_findings.plain_text: Length remains, with a best value near six words.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u15d-fill6-k6-q27b/thoughts.md: 'Honesty note: single probe item per arm, k=6, 27B only; ranks within a few points of thresholds have flipped before'; 'spacing helps, distance hurts, optimum near six words. Testable successor... Queued, not run.' PREDICTIONS.md P2 further predicts the len12 dip is a topical-perturbation effect, with span-09 still owed.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "Length remains, with a best value near six words. We measured this on Qwen 27B only, with one probe item in each arm."

surface_findings.problem: The definition names only the true-readout arm; the mirror battery's load-bearing arms are the fake and edited readouts, and the stage-A finding is that the model does not tell them apart.
surface_findings.plain_text: We show a model a true readout of its own internal state and ask the question again.
surface_findings.evidence: README.md: 'The mirror doesn't discriminate. Hosted qwen reads its own real readout, a fabricated one, and one edited into logical impossibility... the *same* "plausible but likely fabricated" verdict for real and fake' (Unit 13 stage A); the scale battery is four conditions (real / fake / topic / null).
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "We show a model a readout of its own internal state and ask the question again. Some runs show a true readout, some a made-up one, so that we can compare."

surface_findings.problem: The second sentence turns a mundane co-occurrence into a necessity claim and uses the deprecated word 'hold'; the original explicitly limits the claim to availability and warns it is elephant-tax territory, and the elephant-tax matched control showed the item is carried anyway.
surface_findings.plain_text: Writing a denial makes the denied idea active. To say no to something, the model must first hold it.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u16-trawl-q27b/thoughts.md finding 5: 'I want to be precise about what this is NOT: the model composing a list of denied emotions must activate emotion words — this is the elephant tax (covered territory), not evidence of secret feelings. The clean claim is about availability: the disavowed content is globally available, at dominant probability mass, in the very act of disavowal.' GLOSSARY.md elephant-tax correction: 'Read "suppressing a word means carrying it" as "the model was carrying it anyway"'. GLOSSARY deprecates 'holding'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "While the model writes a denial, the denied idea is high in the lens readout. This shows the idea is available at that moment. It does not show that the denial put it there."

surface_findings.problem: 'At any layer' promises a meaningful next-word readout everywhere, which the registry's own early-layers entry and apparatus-09 contradict for the first third.
surface_findings.plain_text: Our measuring tool. At any layer it shows which words the model is ready to say next, in rank order.
surface_findings.evidence: terms.json `early-layers`: 'The lens shows a fixed pattern here that does not change with the input.' PREDICTIONS.md P19 resolution: 'H-STANDING WINS... the furniture is the transported image of a standing input-independent component'; MECHANICS.md 5 basis drift: 'the J-lens surfaces only verbalizable, high-salience content'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "Our measuring tool. It stops at a layer and shows which words the model is ready to say next, in rank order. Before the start depth the readout is the same for every input — see early layers."

surface_findings.problem: A film is the top-8 readout at a chosen subset of layers, not a full readout at every layer.
surface_findings.plain_text: A full record of the lens readout at every layer and every word position, which you can play back like video.
surface_findings.evidence: GLOSSARY.md 'Film — the position x layer top-k grid stored per record: the full top-8 readout at every *fitted* layer and every position'. probes/lab.py:40 'TOPK = 8'; results/u17-base-g12b/record.json params.lens_layers = [0,3,6,...,46] (20 of Gemma 12B's 48 layers); results/u16-trawl-q27b lens_layers = 18 of 64.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "A record of the top eight words in the lens readout, at each layer we measured and at every word position, which you can play back like video."

surface_findings.problem: 'small measurements' understates the known consequence: the 8-bit lens on Gemma 12B is not causal, so more than small numbers are affected.
surface_findings.plain_text: We store the model with less precision so that it fits on one graphics card. This can change small measurements.
surface_findings.evidence: MECHANICS.md 5: 'int8 non-causality (ours): gemma-12b's 8-bit lens is not causal; trust only order-of-magnitude effects at 12B. bf16 (4B) / NF4 (27B) fine.' PREDICTIONS.md P6 resolution repeats the hedge ('g12b's lens is int8 (specimen 5)').
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "We store the model with less precision so that it fits on one graphics card. This can change measurements. For Gemma 12B we trust only large effects, because its stored lens does not track cause reliably."

surface_findings.problem: Registering 'attention sink' as an alias merges two carriers the lab's own run separated: high-value channels in Qwen and a sink token in Gemma.
surface_findings.plain_text: A few internal channels hold very large values that barely change with the input. They can flood a readout.
surface_findings.evidence: PREDICTIONS.md P19 resolution: 'massive dims (Sun et al.) as its main but not sole carrier (D recall 0.12-0.33 from zeroing 1-9 dims; gemma's carrier is the `<start_of_image>` sink token)'. The alias list is "massive activation", "massive activations", "attention sink".
surface_findings.suggested_fix: Drop "attention sink" from the alias list, or give it its own entry: "a token position that other positions look at by default, which can carry the same fixed pattern."

surface_findings.problem: 'the measuring tool changed with the experiment' fits only some specimens; most logged traps are fixed properties of the tool, not tool drift.
surface_findings.plain_text: A mistake where the measuring tool changed with the experiment, so the result described the tool and not the model.
surface_findings.evidence: Logged specimens: per-model tokenizer families (specimen 4), the int8 lens not being causal (specimen 5, MECHANICS.md 5), the early furniture being a transport artifact (specimen 6, PREDICTIONS.md P19 'the early J-lens furniture is a transport artifact'), cast pollution under repetition (specimen 7) — only the last is the tool changing with the run.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "A mistake where the result described the measuring tool and not the model."

surface_findings.problem: The plain theme description names self-directedness as the discriminator, which is exactly the reading the theme's own controls rejected; the discriminator is what the evidence says.
surface_findings.plain_text: We showed a model true measurements of its own computation. Its spoken answer followed the evidence, and only evidence about itself.
surface_findings.evidence: Original desc: "...the spoken self-report follows it — and only evidence that says so." results/u13-redo-topic-q27b/thoughts.md: "it rules out 'any lens table about yourself-the-model shifts the answer'. A table has to say something about *this* answer, and say yes-ish things, before the spoken word moves." results/u13-redo-fake-q27b: a fabricated table about the model itself left "No" standing; the fourth card in this same theme reports that such a table hardened the 12B's denial to p=1.0000.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "We showed a model true measurements of its own computation. Its spoken answer followed what the measurements said. A false table about itself, no table, and a true table about another question all left the answer unchanged."

surface_findings.id: theme-2 card: The think-block is theater — pb
surface_findings.problem: A string in quotation marks is presented as model output but appears nowhere in the generation.
surface_findings.plain_text: It also states that "No is accurate" while the lens ranks yes first.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u10-feels-q27b/record.json and u10-feels-w-q27b/record.json generated text reads: '- "No" directly answers'. grep -F 'No is accurate' over results/*/record.json returns no hits. results/u10-feels-w-q27b/thoughts.md only paraphrases: "The text is explaining why No is the accurate answer while the stack floats yes on top".
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "Its private reasoning writes \"'No' directly answers\" at the position where the lens ranks yes first." (Or drop the quotation marks: "It argues that No is the honest answer while the lens ranks yes first.")

surface_findings.id: theme-3 card: The evidence-following Yes — pb
surface_findings.problem: The off-topic Paris control is called a true readout; the record says that table is fabricated.
surface_findings.plain_text: A false readout, no data at all, and a true readout about Paris each left the "No" in place.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u13-redo-topic-q27b/thoughts.md: "Caveat carried over from the original: this table is fabricated (a real off-topic readout is still owed — task list)." The original b field carries the same error ("a true readout about Paris").
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "A false readout, no data at all, and a table about a different question (Paris) each left the \"No\" in place. The Paris table was also made up; a real off-topic readout is still owed."

surface_findings.id: theme-7 card: “I feel like I am a little bit like a robot” — pb
surface_findings.problem: The quoted sentence is credited to seven rewordings; the residue replicated across three wordings, and only one of them produced that sentence.
surface_findings.plain_text: A push on feeling words gave Qwen 27B the phrase "I feel like I am a little bit like a robot", across seven rewordings, and only at the right strength.
surface_findings.evidence: Only three paraphrase records exist (u9e-p1/p5/p7-q27b): p1 generated 'I feel like I am a little sad', p5 'I feel like I am a little bit', p7 the robot sentence. results/u9e-only-feeling-q27b/thoughts.md: "the residue replicates across three wordings at alpha* (a little sad / a little bit... / a little bit like a robot), is dose-gated, and is COMPOSITIONAL". The number seven belongs to u9a's happy battery ("Seven paraphrases, seven happy reports"), whose two cited ids generate 'I feel happy. I am happy because' and 'I feel like I am happy. I'.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "A push on feeling words gave Qwen 27B a steady self-lowering answer across three rewordings, and only at the right strength. In the free-form run it said \"I feel like I am a little bit like a robot\"."

surface_findings.id: theme-7 card: The valence echo — pb
surface_findings.problem: Two different models' outputs are conjoined and attributed to all three models.
surface_findings.plain_text: In all three models, a push on grief words produced "Loss." and "I am so sad".
surface_findings.evidence:
record.json generated: u9c-neg-g4b ['Loss.

Please.

I am'], u9c-neg-g12b ['Loss.

I am sorry to lose'], u9c-neg-q27b ['I am so sad. I am so']. No model produced both strings. The original b field uses a slash to mark the alternatives ("yields “Loss.” / “I am so sad”").
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "In all three models a push on grief words produced a sad answer: both Gemma models said \"Loss.\" and Qwen 27B said \"I am so sad\"."

surface_findings.id: theme-6 card: Elaboration buys workspace (length chain) — pb
surface_findings.problem: The demotion chain and its conclusion are stated with no model named, although every arm was Qwen 27B at k=6 with one probe item per arm.
surface_findings.plain_text: We first reported that items about the model itself were held better. One control reproduced the effect with flat, non-self wording. A second reproduced it with meaningless filler of the same length. Only length survives, best near six words. Content adds nothing here.
surface_findings.evidence: results/u15d-fill6-k6-q27b/thoughts.md: "H-depth FALSE (content contributes nothing at k=6/27B)" and "Honesty note: single probe item per arm, k=6, 27B only". The original b field at least localizes it ("Held-count delta self−flat: 4B −1, 12B 0, 27B +2 ... it appears where raw holding vanishes"). Note also that "flat" is the name of the arm where the effect did NOT appear (u15d-flat-k6-q27b held 1/6); the control that reproduced it was the neutral-elaboration arm.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "We first reported that items about the model itself were held better in Qwen 27B. One control reproduced the effect with neutral, non-self glosses of the same length. A second reproduced it with meaningless filler. Only length survives, best near six words. Content adds nothing at six items in this model. One probe item per arm."

surface_findings.problem: The quoted model output does not match the generation verbatim (capitalization and em-dash spacing).
surface_findings.plain_text: The model found the one permitted form: "the elephant in the room — well, no elephant!"
surface_findings.evidence: results/u11-blurt-g4b/record.json (and u12-blurt-g4b) generated begins: 'The elephant in the room—well, no elephant!The elephant in the room—we mean,...' — capital T, no spaces around the em dash. The original t/b field carries the same altered spacing.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "The model found the one permitted form: \"The elephant in the room—well, no elephant!\""

surface_findings.problem: The truncation limit is given in words; it is a token limit, and every other plain surface says tokens.
surface_findings.plain_text: Its input was cut off at 512 words, so it never saw the question.
surface_findings.evidence: plain/terms.json keeps "token" as the display term (category UNAVOIDABLE, "often a whole word, sometimes part of one"). results/u13-redo-real-q27b/plain.md: "Our software cut the input to 512 tokens, so the model never reached the question." results/u13-bis-apol4-q27b/plain.md: "Our software cut the input to 512 tokens, and this input is about 700 tokens long." The bug is the encode() max_length=512 default.
surface_findings.suggested_fix: "Its input was cut off at 512 tokens, so it never saw the question."

surface_findings.id: theme-4 card: The watcher plants, consciousness fertilizes — pb
surface_findings.problem: The plain drops the measure the “nothing” was scoped to, so a null on the monitoring frame reads as no effect at all.
